finding.rule: Hair uses bold silhouettes. Never green hair.
finding.words: Tall, rigid cornrows forming a geometric crown, slightly asymmetrical (black)
finding.why: The description specifies a geometric crown, which implies a stylized, potentially exaggerated silhouette that may not be bold or simple enough at game size.

finding.rule: A new character can't be mistakable for anyone already on the roster.
finding.why: Daniel is not one of the original ten names (Larry, Doug, Norm, Greg, Carl, Steve, Barry, Terry, Kevin, Phil), so this is not a name conflict, but the name 'Daniel' is not listed as a permitted name in the current roster, and the set's names must follow the 'comically stereotypical but not offensive' guideline, which may not be met by this name.
